title: Base layout: shorten repeated journeys
applies_when: A new base section or expansion needs a site.
approach: Cluster food storage, cooking and dining so repeated ingredient and meal trips stay short. Give diners a route to food that bypasses the kitchen.
Place workshops near their input storage. Leave access and expansion space before surrounding productive rooms with other buildings.
Reuse suitable nearby ruins where they reduce initial labor. Build a usable first section of a larger plan; reserved expansion is not an instruction to build everything now.
Treat these as layout tradeoffs, not a mandatory template. Existing structures, terrain, threats and player preferences decide the site.
verify: Check actual walking access and room use after construction.
reconsider: A shorter geometric distance still requires a long detour or disrupts existing work.
